name: Throw Voice
body:
Benefit: You have learned to throw your voice and may do so with- out the aid of magic. To fool a target, make a Bluff check opposed by the listener’s Perception. If you succeed, the listener cannot tell the voice is coming from you and in- stead hears it coming from a place you specify. You may make your voice sound like it is coming from any place within hearing range except behind the listener.
